but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to Yahweh, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the…

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.
translations.bsb: It will be a special portion for them set apart from the land, a most holy portion adjacent to the territory of the Levites.
translations.kjv: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
translations.asv: And it shall be unto them an oblation from the oblation of the land, a thing most holy, by the border of the Levites.
